title: The sounds of shared walls
context: An apartment wall separates one person's home from another. Sound isn't quite as respectful of boundaries. This installation uses recordings and found objects to explore the acoustic relationship between private and shared space.

sources.label: SAIC Graduate Exhibition 2025: Mauricio López F.

related.relation: also makes the overlooked audible, like
related.note: One amplifies the life heard through apartment walls; the other turns a tree's live signals into sound.

editorialNotes: Sound sculpture (2024): recordings of an inhabited apartment through an amplification system, with card catalog drawers, a stool, steel pipes and steel sheet (artist's site).
